plan.title: Edit Evaluation Time Rejects Zero and Negative Durations

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab, where the Settings menu is available.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Set the post-expiry surrogate-bid setting required by the case.
Enable buyer editing of bidding fields as required by the case.
Apply the case's evaluation-reopen permission setting.
Open Edit Evaluation Time, enter -5 minutes, submit, and verify that Procol refuses the negative duration.
Repeat the same dialog check with a zero-minute duration and verify that Procol refuses it.
